scope: Chairman continuation: research and isolated prototypes only, no production deployment, trading, alerts, ranking, sizing, new persistent plane or purchases. Independent from original blocked network/shock/DEEP+ result access.
source_vintage: Official French August2026 CRSP full-reconstruction files 10/49 Industry Portfolios Daily + FF 3factor daily; historical June SIC classifications but later-vintage reconstructed returns, not real-time source vintages or directly tradable ETF prices.

universe.other_catchall: Official 10-way Other is default for unlisted SIC codes.
universe.selection: Classification/code coverage and past-only availability; not selected by future returns. A parent with a pure child not representing all company weights must not be called an exact aggregation.
universe.mixed_children: NEVER fractionally allocate without firm composition/weights.

origin: Actual Fridays from2000 to2026 with complete baseline/candidate asof close t. Entry convention is t+1 close; no origin determined by future label.
forecast_target: Binary meaningful RS21 benchmark-relative sign change: if current21-session log relative sum RS_t has abs >=0.005, label YES when future RS21 has opposite sign with abs >=0.005 on 3 consecutive complete sessions ending by t+21; earliest confirmation time is end of third day. Entire future t+1..t+21 observed, else censored/excluded with reason. Initial small abs<.005 not admitted (prefix-only). Both positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive included.
time: Daily logreturn to t close, hypothetical t+1 close entry, train full label ends strictly before start of test calendar year, rolling20year annual expanding/rolling fits. No future return in a feature, no target label that confirms after horizon.

baseline.sector_identity: Parent dummies or categorical effects fitted on training only, retained same across models.

model: Baseline fixed ridge logistic L2=.01 mean loss with training-only zscore/clipping +-5, intercept unpenalized. Primary calibrated baseline adds a single train-only intercept correction. Candidate uses same fixed baseline logit offset and train-only residualized child features projected off baseline transformed columns; candidate coefficients ridge .01 without intercept. This prevents duplicated baseline columns from changing its shrinkage. No candidate re-estimation of baseline coefficients.
controls: Four independently fixed seed child-to-parent reassignment maps preserving group counts, using all selected pure children but scrambling identities; each uses the same feature vector, common-origin panel, fitting/penalty, and evaluated on same dates. This is identity-specificity only, not proof of causal migration.

periods.reserve: 2026 through fully observed last target, descriptive only

primary_metrics: paired Brier gain across date-cross-section means vs calibrated baseline
logloss and ROC AUC for event vs non-event
event precision at matched top20pct weekly alert budget (ceiling, same eligible parents)
conditional median lead to 3-day confirmation with event denominator
declustered by parent21tradingday cooldown and lost alert count
subgroup by positive/negative current RS sign
inference: 1000 circular26-week-date block resamples on paired daily/weekly group meanBrier gain seed910152026. A one-day/date group is the uncertainty unit, not each child/parent. Reserve suppressed for confidence if fewer104dates; estimates descriptive.
gate: Research-promising-only if primary Brier gain >=.002, lower95pctblockbound>0, 2of3primaryeras gain positive, equalalertprecision improvement >=.02 and no logloss degradation, and real-map Brier gain higher than all four scrambled-map gains. No production/rank/trade unless later PIT independent replication with costs and real consumer/provenance.
constraints: This study is independent of denied original IEX/source/result read and old unresolved Fabric return; neither is retried or rerouted.
No hidden capital-flow/ownership identification from portfolio returns.
SIC codes are not a source of firm-level weights; pure subset nonexhaustive.
This is adaptive research after prior failures; avoid claims of globally pristine discovery holdout.
No output vendor raw data/per-origin predictions to public repo.
do_not_redo: Original LP-ETF-01/02/03/04, prior industry reverse/shock, and network original experiments are not rerun or overwritten.
